root.name: Tarrasch Defense: Schara Gambit
root.moves: 1. d4 d5 2. c4 e6 3. Nc3 c5 4. cxd5 cxd4

overview: After 4.cxd5 cxd4 White usually grabs with 5.Qxd4 Nc6 or 5.Qa4+ Bd7 6.Qxd4 exd5 7.Qxd5. Black gives a pawn for rapid development and queen harassment: ...Nc6, ...Nf6, ...Bc5 and queenside castling. The main-line positions are open and double-edged, with Black chasing the white king and queen; correct defence leaves White a clear pawn, so it is a gambit that needs accurate memory.

white_ideas.idea: Take the d4 pawn and retreat the queen to d1 or d3, develop Nf3 and e3 to consolidate
Keep the extra pawn and trade queens when possible

black_ideas.idea: Gain tempi against the queen with ...Nc6 and ...Nf6, castle long and open the e- and d-files
Build Bc5 and ...Qe7 with attack on the king in the centre

typical_structures.structure: White a pawn up (extra pawn on d5 or d4 gone) with open central files and Black ahead in development

character.notes: Black sacrifices a pawn for initiative and the queens come into play early. Sharp.

gambit.notes: After 7.Qxd5 Nc6 White is a pawn up and can keep it with careful play.

soundness.notes: Theory gives White an edge but Black gets real compensation; not refuted, so Sound, with doubts.

structure.notes: The centre opens quickly with files and diagonals for the pieces.

approach.notes: A rare gambit that strong players seldom choose as Black, mainly a surprise.

level.notes: Forcing queen-chase lines must be known on both sides. Intermediate leaning Advanced.

sublines_that_differ.name: 5.Qxd4 Nc6 6.Qd1 exd5
sublines_that_differ.how: White returns the queen to d1 and Black regains the pawn with an isolated pawn structure, less of a gambit.

character.reason: Open lines, queen harassment and a pawn sacrificed for initiative.

gambit.reason: Black gives the d-pawn for time in the Qa4+ main line.

soundness.reason: White keeps an edge but Black gets sufficient play; not close to refuted.

structure.reason: Central pawns come off early and the pieces use open lines.

approach.reason: Not a regular choice for strong players.

level.reason: Forcing lines to know, but short and clear.

plans.reason: Black develops quickly for the sacrificed pawn.
